details.corrected: Operator ruling: OpenCode V2 is released and in production use (v2.0.26 confirmed installed locally and on multiple operator machines) -- it is not dev-branch-only as the prior correction on this mission stated. This integration targets V2. The prior correction's claim that 'V2 is still dev-branch, not a cut release' is retracted as factually wrong; the underlying technical finding (the document's plugin-hook vocabulary was V1, not V2) stands and still needs the hook-name vocabulary updated before this document is Z-spec input. V2's confirmed current hook API (Plugin.define({id, setup(ctx)}) with ctx.session.hook/ctx.tool.hook/ctx.event.subscribe/ctx.shell.hook/ctx.permission.hook, per the dev branch's migrate-v1.mdx V1-to-V2 migration table) is the vocabulary to formalize.
